<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.craftmarket.mapper.MarketEventMapper">

    <!-- 根据状态查询活动列表 -->
    <select id="selectEventsByStatus" resultType="com.craftmarket.entity.MarketEvent">
        SELECT * FROM market_event
        WHERE status = #{status} AND deleted = 0
        ORDER BY event_start_time DESC
    </select>

    <!-- 查询活动中可用摊位（按区域） -->
    <select id="selectAvailableBoothsByEvent" resultType="com.craftmarket.entity.MarketEvent">
        SELECT 
            me.*,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booth b 
             WHERE b.event_id = me.id 
             AND b.area = #{area}
             AND b.status = 'AVAILABLE' 
             AND b.deleted = 0) AS available_booths_count
        FROM market_event me
        WHERE me.id = #{eventId} AND me.deleted = 0
    </select>

</mapper>
